gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-cascadia-mono: Cascadia Mono stands its letters upright like pins, capitals nearly dissolving into the lowercase. Bushcraft is the expressive one, spacing its closed, uniform-weight shapes wide for a hand-made look, while the plain sans body simply keeps text open and legible.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-lexend-exa: Lexend Exa has a big x-height and stubby ascenders, with curves that stay wide open. Bushcraft does its best work in closed, widely spaced display letters, while Lexend Exa handles the sustained reading in a sans with unvarying thickness.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-lexend-giga: Flat and spacious, with generous tracking. Bushcraft's closed, wide-set display letters want plenty of size, and Lexend Giga, a sans-serif with open shapes, can sit comfortably smaller underneath.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-lexend-mega: Bushcraft spaces its letters extra wide. Lexend Mega's sans body, drawn as if with one nib and with gaps in every c, reads smoothly, so the closed heading forms feel even more deliberate.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-montserrat-alter: Chalkboard-style lowercase, crowding up toward the capital line. Montserrat Alternates is the pair's strongest card, its open round letters setting off Bushcraft's closed, widely spaced display shapes.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-cascadia-mo: Cascadia Mono reads like pins in a wide board, with capitals blending into a compact lowercase. Capture Smallz brings raw, big-bodied lowercase on top, and that gap between display heading and sans body is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-lexend-exa: Lexend Exa, a sans-serif with wide-open curves and no stroke contrast, reads in smooth, steady lines beneath Capture Smallz. Its big x-height keeps the flow easy.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-lexend-giga: Lexend Giga reads in flat, single-weight lines with generous tracking, so every word breathes. Under Capture Smallz, that sans-serif settles into a steady, relaxed pace.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-lexend-mega: Approachable describes Lexend Mega, a sans-serif drawn like one nib with open gaps in each c. Capture Smallz brings raw, big-bodied lowercase, while Lexend Mega lets the text settle into clear, uniform strokes.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-lexend-tera: Raw, big-bodied lowercase meets plotter-pen lines. Capture Smallz is rough and tactical, and Lexend Tera, a clean sans with open curves and stepping-stone spacing, gives the pair its strongest quality: contrast.
